luckyChest.probability: Existing verified native sampler rand()%(sumWeights+1), inclusive cumulative boundary; first row gets the additional boundary outcome.

normalLottery.poolRule: Default3; level>=30 uses min(8,floor(level/10)+1); level>=80 and paragon>=100 switches to9; an additional external condition switches to10.
normalLottery.limit: Name/meaning of pool10 extra external condition not decoded.

activeLottery.limit: Activity availability and schedule not confirmed.

battleTreasure.poolRule: Default60; levels61..80 use min(8,floor(level/10)+1)*10; level80 and paragon>=100 uses90.

limits: Only pool1 uses the verified lucky chest probability formula here. Other pools show original weights, not percentages.
Reward itemtype3 resolves to pet data; itemtype1 and2 resolve to item data.
Reading a candidate pool does not prove that every reward is granted at once or that all pools share a selection algorithm.
